title: Wag and the Red Wig
lines: Ned and his pup Wag run a lot.
Ned has a red wig in his bag.
He sets it on Wag. Wag wags!
But Wag ran at a wet bog.
The wig got wet and got mud on it.
Ned is not mad. He hugs his wet pup.
"Wag did win a wet hug," he said.

questions.ask: What did Ned have in his bag?
questions.listenFor: A red wig. It is said in the second line. If they guess, have them find the line with the word bag in it.

questions.ask: How did the wig get wet?
questions.listenFor: Wag ran into the wet bog while wearing it. Two steps, so it is fine if your child needs to look back at the lines to get both.

questions.ask: Do you think Ned should be cross with Wag? Tell me why or why not.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer. Listen for a reason - Wag did not mean it, or Ned was the one who put the wig on the pup. Push gently for the because.
